description: Resolve assignee shows each alternative's value as a raw 70-character Actor ID ('actor-6b8ee6b3…40c8'), broken mid-token. The person must choose between values they cannot read. It only works here because each author assigned themselves. History renders the same value as 'Kept Maya Okafor', so a name formatter exists.
expected: Alternatives read 'Juniper · agent' / 'Maya Okafor · human' (or 'Unassigned' for null), with buttons 'Keep Juniper' / 'Keep Maya Okafor'.
suggested_fix: Format conflict values per field: Actor IDs via labelActor, status via status labels, tags as chips, null as 'Unassigned'.
